title: Kedarnath
reportingPoint: Akshardham Metro Station, Delhi. Departure is around 9:00 PM on the departure night.
highlights: Kedarnath Ji darshan and a night at the dham
Drive via Devprayag and Rudraprayag along the Alaknanda and Mandakini
Tolls, tax, parking and driver allowance included
overview:
A **3 Nights / 4 Days** Kedarnath yatra from Delhi: you leave Akshardham Metro Station around 9 PM by AC Traveller and travel overnight to Guptkashi.

Day 1 drives up via Devprayag and Rudraprayag along the Alaknanda and Mandakini, with prayers at the Ardh Narishwar temple and a night in Guptkashi. Day 2 is the drive to Sonprayag, a local jeep to Gaurikund and the 19-20 km trek to Kedarnath (helicopter tickets can be booked separately), with darshan and a night at the dham. Day 3 starts with the morning pooja, then the way back down to Sonprayag and Guptkashi. Day 4 is the drive back to Delhi after breakfast. Prices start at ₹11,499 per person on quad sharing (5% GST extra). The last batch of the 2026 season leaves on 6 November.

itinerary.title: Departure from Delhi
itinerary.content:
Report at Akshardham Metro Station and meet our representative.
Leave Delhi around 9 PM by AC Traveller for the overnight journey to Guptkashi.

itinerary.title: Devprayag, Rudraprayag and Guptkashi
itinerary.content:
Drive up via Devprayag and Rudraprayag, with views of the Alaknanda and Mandakini.
Visit the Ardh Narishwar temple at Guptkashi and offer prayers.
Check in to the hotel in Guptkashi.
Rest and recharge for the trek ahead.

itinerary.title: Gaurikund to Kedarnath trek (19-20 km)
itinerary.content:
After breakfast, drive to Sonprayag and take a local jeep to Gaurikund.
Trek 19-20 km to Kedarnath. Prefer to fly? Helicopter tickets can be booked separately (not included).
Darshan and time at the dham, then overnight at a hotel in Kedarnath.

itinerary.title: Kedarnath to Guptkashi
itinerary.content:
Morning pooja at the shrine and breakfast, then check out.
Head back down to Sonprayag, where your driver picks you up, then drive to Guptkashi.
Rest of the day free at the hotel.

itinerary.title: Guptkashi to Delhi
itinerary.content: After breakfast, drive back to Delhi.

faqs.q: Where and when does the trip start?

faqs.q: How much does the Kedarnath trip cost?
faqs.a: ₹11,499 per person on quad sharing, ₹11,999 on triple sharing and ₹12,499 on double sharing. 5% GST is extra.
The last batch of the 2026 season runs from 6 to 11 November 2026. Call or WhatsApp +91 98117 83209 to book.

faqs.q: What do I need to carry?
faqs.a: A valid government photo ID is a must: there is no boarding without it. Also pack a down or main jacket, thermals, socks and gloves, good shoes, a daypack, personal medication and a small first-aid kit. The full list is under Things To Pack.
